Name: Jedi Guardian
Description: This Jedi battles against the forces of evil and the dark side. They focus on combat training and masterful use of the lightsaber.

Name: Jedi Consular
Description: This Jedi seeks to bring balance to the universe. They focus less on physical combat and more on mental disciplines in order to augment their mastery of the Force.

Name: Jedi Sentinel
Description: This Jedi ferrets out deceit and injustice, bringing it to light. They strike a balance between the physical and mental disciplines of the Jedi Order.

Name: Scoundrel
Description: Scoundrels survive through wit and guile, traits that sometimes place them on the wrong side of the law. Intelligence, Dexterity, and Charisma are the trademarks of a scoundrel.

Name: Scout
Description: Scouts are explorers, trained to understand their surroundings and how to survive in them. Dexterity, Intelligence, and Wisdom are the most important abilities of a scout.

Name: Soldier
Description: Soldiers are masters of combat in all its forms, believing that the best way to survive a fight is to win it. Dexterity, Constitution, and Strength are key to an effective soldier.

Name: Combat Droid
Description: Combat Droids come in all shapes and sizes. Programmed essentially for combat purposes, they nonetheless possess an emotional matrix, allowing them the ability to interact normally with organic meat bags such as humans and twi'lek.

Name: Expert Droid
Description: Expert Droids are mainly used by governments and independent agencies for espionage purposes: slicing, security and intelligence gathering. They are highly adaptable, and can be used in combat situations as well.

Name: Sith Warrior
Description: Seek strength in war and rage. Born for battle, few opponents can withstand the rage-fueled blows from a warrior's lightsaber.

Name: Sith Sorcerer
Description: The Dark Side holds dangerous secrets – and immense strength for those who dare to uncover them. Recognize what strength is, and bring that strength to those that follow you… and those that defy you.

Name: Sith Assassin
Description: The ways of darkness and shadow, the power that comes from striking unseen and sensing weaknesses in others… the ways of the assassins of the Sith.
